sources.title: szl-holdings/szl-forge: SZL Forge - GitHub
sources.snippet: Train SZL-1 — SZL Holdings' own model — on SZL's own metal. SZL Forge is a small, self-contained fine-tuning kit. It turns an open base model into SZL-1: a sovereign model whose identity, doctrine, and weights live on SZL's own hardware and are served through Ollama like any other estate model.
